# yccdn.ru
> Russian-language site for Yandex Cloud CDN documentation, product information, and related cloud service references.

The site focuses on Yandex Cloud CDN capabilities, setup, integration, security, and operational guidance within the broader Yandex Cloud ecosystem.

## CDN Overview
- [Yandex Cloud CDN](https://yccdn.ru/): Main landing page for Yandex Cloud CDN features, benefits, and service overview.
- [Documentation](https://yccdn.ru/docs/): Entry point for CDN documentation, concepts, setup, and operational guidance.
- [Pricing](https://yccdn.ru/pricing): Pricing information for CDN usage and related service costs.
- [FAQ](https://yccdn.ru/faq): Frequently asked questions about CDN behavior, setup, and billing.
- [Support](https://yccdn.ru/support): Support options, contact paths, and help resources for CDN users.

## Getting Started
- [Quick Start](https://yccdn.ru/docs/quickstart): Initial steps to configure and launch CDN distribution.
- [Create a Resource](https://yccdn.ru/docs/create-resource): Guide to creating a CDN resource and basic delivery settings.
- [Connect Origin](https://yccdn.ru/docs/connect-origin): Instructions for linking an origin server or storage backend.
- [Configure DNS](https://yccdn.ru/docs/configure-dns): DNS setup guidance for routing traffic through CDN.
- [HTTPS Setup](https://yccdn.ru/docs/https): Steps for enabling HTTPS and certificate configuration.

## Concepts
- [How CDN Works](https://yccdn.ru/docs/concepts/how-it-works): Core concepts of content delivery, caching, and edge distribution.
- [Resources and Origins](https://yccdn.ru/docs/concepts/resources-origins): Explanation of CDN resources, origins, and delivery relationships.
- [Caching](https://yccdn.ru/docs/concepts/caching): Cache behavior, TTL handling, and content freshness concepts.
- [Cache Invalidation](https://yccdn.ru/docs/concepts/cache-invalidation): Overview of purge and invalidation mechanisms.
- [Security](https://yccdn.ru/docs/concepts/security): Security model, HTTPS delivery, and access protection concepts.

## Configuration Guides
- [Cache Settings](https://yccdn.ru/docs/guides/cache-settings): Guide to tuning cache rules and content retention behavior.
- [Custom Domains](https://yccdn.ru/docs/guides/custom-domains): Configure custom hostnames for CDN-delivered content.
- [Origin Shielding](https://yccdn.ru/docs/guides/origin-shielding): Reduce origin load with shielding and optimized request routing.
- [Compression](https://yccdn.ru/docs/guides/compression): Enable and manage compression for faster content delivery.
- [Access Control](https://yccdn.ru/docs/guides/access-control): Restrict access and configure delivery protection settings.
- [HTTP Headers](https://yccdn.ru/docs/guides/http-headers): Manage request and response headers affecting CDN behavior.

## Operations
- [Purge Cache](https://yccdn.ru/docs/operations/purge-cache): Remove cached content from edge nodes on demand.
- [Update Resource](https://yccdn.ru/docs/operations/update-resource): Modify existing CDN resource settings and delivery parameters.
- [Delete Resource](https://yccdn.ru/docs/operations/delete-resource): Remove a CDN resource and stop content delivery.
- [Monitoring](https://yccdn.ru/docs/operations/monitoring): Observe CDN performance, usage, and operational metrics.
- [Logs](https://yccdn.ru/docs/operations/logs): Access and use logs for troubleshooting and analytics.

## API and Automation
- [API Reference](https://yccdn.ru/docs/api/): Reference for programmatic management of CDN resources.
- [REST API](https://yccdn.ru/docs/api/rest): REST endpoints for creating and managing CDN configuration.
- [Authentication](https://yccdn.ru/docs/api/authentication): Authentication methods and credentials for API access.
- [CLI](https://yccdn.ru/docs/cli/): Command-line workflows for managing CDN resources.
- [Terraform](https://yccdn.ru/docs/terraform/): Infrastructure as code examples for provisioning CDN resources.

## Integrations
- [Object Storage](https://yccdn.ru/docs/integrations/object-storage): Use Object Storage as an origin for CDN content delivery.
- [Load Balancer](https://yccdn.ru/docs/integrations/load-balancer): Integrate CDN with load balancing for resilient delivery.
- [Certificate Manager](https://yccdn.ru/docs/integrations/certificate-manager): Manage TLS certificates for secure CDN endpoints.
- [DNS](https://yccdn.ru/docs/integrations/dns): Connect DNS services for domain routing and validation.
- [Monitoring Services](https://yccdn.ru/docs/integrations/monitoring): Send CDN metrics and events to monitoring tools.

## Troubleshooting
- [Troubleshooting Guide](https://yccdn.ru/docs/troubleshooting): Common issues, diagnostics, and resolution steps for CDN setups.
- [HTTP Errors](https://yccdn.ru/docs/troubleshooting/http-errors): Diagnose origin and edge HTTP error responses.
- [Cache Misses](https://yccdn.ru/docs/troubleshooting/cache-misses): Investigate unexpected cache bypasses and low hit ratios.
- [TLS Problems](https://yccdn.ru/docs/troubleshooting/tls): Resolve certificate, HTTPS, and handshake issues.
- [DNS Issues](https://yccdn.ru/docs/troubleshooting/dns): Fix domain resolution and routing problems affecting CDN access.

## Related Yandex Cloud Resources
- [Yandex Cloud](https://cloud.yandex.ru/): Main Yandex Cloud platform with product catalog and account access.
- [Yandex Cloud Documentation](https://cloud.yandex.ru/docs/): Central documentation hub for Yandex Cloud services.
- [Object Storage Documentation](https://cloud.yandex.ru/docs/storage/): Docs for object storage often used as CDN origin.
- [Certificate Manager Documentation](https://cloud.yandex.ru/docs/certificate-manager/): Docs for certificate lifecycle management with CDN.
- [Cloud DNS Documentation](https://cloud.yandex.ru/docs/dns/): DNS service documentation for domain configuration with CDN.
- [Monitoring Documentation](https://cloud.yandex.ru/docs/monitoring/): Monitoring service docs for metrics, alerts, and dashboards.
